en: Black‑and‑white view of a grand neoclassical colonnaded building set in a manicured park. The façade has a long arcade of arches on slender columns, with sculpted friezes and reliefs in the pediments. A broad staircase leads up to the entrance. In the foreground are curving paths, trimmed hedges, flowerbeds, lampposts, and a central statue of a bust on a tall pedestal. The overall look is of a 19th‑century spa or promenade hall in a landscaped garden.
